newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BOLIVIAN INTERNATIONAL SANCHEZ FACES KNEE SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOLIVIAN INTERNATIONAL SANCHEZ FACES KNEE SURGERY.

text.p: Bolivian World Cup midfielder Erwin Sanchez will need knee surgery that is expected to sideline him for up to six months, his Portuguese club Boavista said on Friday.
Team doctor Rui Ramos said Sanchez, injured in Tuesday's UEFA Cup win over Odense of Denmark, would undergo surgery to his right knee at the beginning of next week.
Sanchez started playing again at the start of the season after serving a four-month suspension for failing a dope test.
His urine was found to contain more than the permitted amount of caffeine when he was tested after a match in January.
